column1: While this Order remains in force, I, the Director General of Animal Production and Health, hereby prohibit the following
activities within or in relation to the susceptible areas in order to prevent the spread, control and containment of African

column2: Under Section 5(4) of the Animal Diseases Act, the removal, transportation, driving, or movement of pigs, pork,
pork products, or risk material within, to, or from the infected or susceptible area without a permit issued by
the Divisional Government Veterinary Surgeon of the respective Division, as per Form VII of the regulations
published in Gazette No. 1108/23 dated December 03, 1999;
The slaughter of  pigs for meat purposes without a transport permit issued  as per the above provisions;
Sale, display for sale, offering for sale, storage, supply, distribution, or further processing of pigs, pork, pork
products, or infected materials without a permit issued by an Authorized Officer nominated in this Order;
IV.  Without complying with the guidelines issued by the Department of Animal Production and Health, dispose of
any carcass, part thereof, or contaminated material by placing it in any water body or leaving it in any location
in a manner that may allow other animals to access, consume, or transport such materials to other places;
Slaughtering, storing or processing in any slaughterhouse, storage facility, or meat processing center that is not
approved by an Authorized Officer nominated in this Order.
